result.keyword: What's the best CRM for a small team?
result.markdown:
For most small teams, I'd recommend **HubSpot CRM** as the starting point. It's relatively easy to use, has a generous free version, and can grow with your business.

However, the best choice depends on whether you're primarily managing sales, clients, marketing or ongoing customer relationships.

## My top 5 CRM recommendations

![21 Best CRM Enterprise Software Reviewed For 2026](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/E3oBllJko6DSkC1G-YxonkpSd-C9EJzphRnffFc13dKq176hHlHIBef_KD3uo3Rj4h1fcldcCQ6woqfNfkWWmNW8Rs1_qiHKjMrnT7yrtNAkkpWII-RvqcBN_-0EERClJKgsbj3AQum9lvjpnXVV_ofvoY4dYvM4uvHF3Aza7RJS9SAW_-O73lSaxuQ1_7Sl?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. HubSpot**

(Best overall)

- Free plan available for 2 users
- Contacts, deals, tasks and email tracking
- Excellent marketing and sales integrations
- Easy for non-technical teams

Best for: Small businesses wanting an all-round CRM.

[Explore HubSpot](https://www.hubspot.com/products/crm)

---

![Pipedrive Culture | Comparably](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/LL0qs5ZEn5bajHXZMpCmlJ4Q8G8bG-uCRPdMDaugOTZ5M83xr5SdfSJtpaTsU9pV5XZU_j6tdK98aLeb5eQtmf3jAulEyqWXtwu_NCqqantmt4RgTKgW92e5jqAqiwI5Gvz6HoJSFRLf0DV2WCKF0F5we1qdhyYgERFOvFPWSwO__wWT47lukE3R9cSOeuBr?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Pipedrive**

(Best for sales teams)

- Very intuitive visual sales pipeline
- Excellent deal and follow-up tracking
- Sales-focused automation
- Paid plans from approximately A\$19/user/month

Best for: Teams managing leads, prospects and sales opportunities.

[Explore Pipedrive](https://www.pipedrive.com/)

---

![TheProwess | Zoho CRM'de Yeni Dönem: Eski Arayüz 15 Temmuz'da Tamamen Kaldırılıyor](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/mhOzD_IXTeMyjegHs7_31H-nZlvGoIQWY2PfiTmHpwuQOA09A9NutmTAM8TWT2HF-7JryptkgV-lS_xHcaI7d43ujbBUTvqfxj-z3nk-gdRQr3-Ei-qigHIPik-T14ytWC4EuYLl0he93dU9qCw5sHTS1LPdprZuUjTWv0UHX5wzcmxSTdtKBrPPwq-xdGBE?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Zoho CRM**

(Best value)

- Free plan for up to 3 users
- Highly customisable
- Strong automation and reporting
- Paid plans from approximately A\$22/user/month

Best for: Businesses wanting lots of functionality without spending too much.

[Explore Zoho CRM](https://www.zoho.com/crm/)

---

![Descargar Freshsales CRM varies-with-device para Web Apps - Filehippo.com](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/ymGWkXtkAC7MoWysGML3OKgHF9O0MPKH1PfAAeDjk1aaZrRWaVBb9r5y-Kf_8j4xYqKU0KB7QvzLaYT0HE0Vv7VVhtrsyXiqQzkmNrQWCEXFxliHIByLJsgnf2ztG74VQ6KpL_qyhXQE--CUkaD3WIbFGDInuBn5hMKNEjmTwahJ5xR1Qf4y9c43huoiOovk?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Freshsales**

- Built-in phone, email and chat
- Sales automation and AI features
- Relatively affordable entry-level plans

Best for: Teams that communicate with customers frequently.

[Explore Freshsales](https://www.freshworks.com/crm/sales/)

---

![monday.com Products | Boost Productivity Today — Elevate Operations](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/9pbfxtp9MRSzmGqOOXUT3zYq1fPIuocDylKAQoIzVyuW1Vjc44XoGiROM2GBYduUngwZNPfMFXzqdnmJ1poftmoV-bK85Cp0YYpYmV5sjFjpnjYHjyVWJd9MpDQXQDk0zHwEfS7B57VsWkUtP1cpZQ-ZPXVz1YthngyreHroaIgVKVfnbNj-IFVycI5aW_GQ?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. monday CRM**

- Very visual and collaborative
- CRM combined with task management
- Customisable workflows and dashboards

Best for: Teams managing clients alongside projects and operations.

[Explore monday CRM](https://monday.com/crm)
